source.detail: DFSA Single Family Office listing (ref F003179), verified still active 2026-09-24. Confirmed active and currently operating from DIFC, founded 2013, running a large diversified global portfolio. ⚠ This is the family office of Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the UAE. It is recorded because it is a real, active entity in our segment — NOT because it is an approachable prospect. Any contact at all is Andre's decision alone and nothing about this record should be treated as routine.
